title: Zulu legend that the moon brought us out of the Younger Dryas
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Zulu legend that the moon brought us out of the Younger Dryas, about Younger Dryas at Southern Africa (Zulu), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And there's actually a Zulu legend that the moon brought us out of the younger dus and that it it it it made the the climate stable on Earth.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says there is a legend among the Zulu people of southern Africa that the moon brought humanity out of the Younger Dryas, a sudden cold spell near the end of the last ice age, and made Earth's climate stable. He tells it in an episode exploring the idea that the moon might be an alien spaceship, where the legend would hint that the moon arrived or acted on purpose within human memory.
